content_zh:
林新光手里的扇子松落在地上也没发现，眼里隐隐泛起一丝酸意。
“我就说大少爷绝不会是那种吃软饭的....”被吓到的人群里，有女人小声咬着耳朵。
一些心思灵活的人已经开始在心头打好腹稿了，‘林家大少恶斗夜袭黑衣人’，以后的谈资那是丰富了。
大多数林家族人和下人们更多的是对以前误会林新如的歉疚，以及好奇和刮目相看。
毕竟刚才那人厉害得没边了，这么多高手都挡不住，只有林家大少爷挡住了，这岂不是说林家少爷比起城里的陈坤捕头，还有那位王大人等高手都要厉害？
乖乖，这可不得了了。
有些心头明了的人已经开始盘算以后怎么巴结林新如少爷了。
“这次要不是大少爷出手，恐怕林家就有**烦了。”此时那位王大人缓过气来，捂着胸口坐到大堂中间乱七八糟的破烂椅子上。
“现在已经有**烦了....”陈坤捕头苦笑道，踉跄坐过来。“想不到大家传言一事无成的林家大少爷，居然是传说中的内家高手。失礼失礼了...”
“客气。”林新可不是什么内家高手，但现在只能硬撑，万一那个黑衣人没走远听到他不是内家高手，那就麻烦了。
“只是不知道您说的**烦是...”
陈坤捕头摇头。
“此事一会儿详谈。”
林新点头。
“大哥，你是什么时候....？”林新媛从后面跑出来，双眼放光的抓住林新的手，这表妹从来都是活泼好动，尤其喜好武艺、马术。
“没大没小的，回去呆着。”林志武这时才赶过来，刚才他也跟着林新虎去抓人了，此时一条手臂血淋淋的走进门。显然受了伤。
他环顾一圈后，看了眼站在林志文身前的林新如，以及走到他身边嘟着嘴的安颖，再看了看大堂上方钉着的那把长剑，顿时微微倒抽一口冷气。显然是想到了刚才可能发生的什么。
“此事一会儿再说！”林志文沉声说了句，“现在所有人按照原定计划安排。”
“好。”林志武迟疑了下，但还是点头应声。
“其他人先跟着我进内屋。”林志文在林新如和林新媛的搀扶下，腿脚都有些发软，慢慢进了内屋。

族内的一大帮子表弟表妹，各种表姐表兄等，还有一些凑来仰人鼻息的远亲，也都纷纷为几人让开一条路。
林新如走在林志文左侧，目光环视，视线触及到的每个人，无论老少都不由自主的低头避开他的眼神，有的露出一丝敬畏，有的是不自然有些尴尬，那个衣着有些暴露的绿裙少女却是落落大方的朝他抛了个媚眼，似乎隐隐有勾引之意。
“哼！”安颖在身后忍不住哼哼。
林新如反手对她伸了个大拇指。
“配合不错！”他嘴角泛起一丝笑意。
这小丫头刚才只是听了他一次吩咐，就配合这么默契，真是绝佳的好队友！
安颖正拿着剑晃来晃去，有点憋屈不爽，看到林新如的手势，顿时小脸露出一丝喜意，马上就心情好起来。
走到门口时，林新看到林新光，这家伙面色发白，像是见鬼了一般盯着他。
懒得理他，几人进了内屋。
安抚诸人的事有事先安排好的人手去做，真正的几个核心都聚在一起，单独到了一个小房间，外面守着人，以防止偷听。
林志文林志武坐在一起，然后是陈坤捕头，王大人，林新，其余人都不在，安颖不是林家人，自然没道理掺和进来。
而舒家那高手现在还是昏迷着。所以真正参与核心的就这么几个人。
林志文坐在凳子上，狠狠舒了口气。
“这次林家得以暂时脱难，全靠几位大力支持啊。”他双手拱拳向王大人和陈坤道谢。
“林家主客气了，这也是各取所需，我们收了足够满意的好处，出力抵御也是自然。”王大人露出惭愧之色，“只是没想到这次来的居然是内家高手，要不是有林家大少在，这次我们可真的是功亏一篑。林家的礼物，我也是受之有愧啊。”
陈坤在边上也是露出一丝惭愧。
“说得对，老头子收这礼也是有点不对心，没怎么出到力。”
“两位太过客气了。那青萝刀居然能够出动内家高手，实在是出乎我预料。”林志文苦笑道。

content_en:
The fan in Lin Xinguang's hand fell to the ground without noticing it, and there was a hint of sourness in his eyes.
"I just said that the eldest young master will never be the kind of person who eats soft food..." A woman in the frightened crowd bit her ears in a low voice.
Some people with flexible minds have already started to make plans in their minds, "The young master of the Lin family will fight against the man in black at night", which will be rich for future discussions.
Most of the Lin family and servants felt more sorry for misunderstanding Lin Xinru in the past, and were curious and impressed.
After all, the man just now was so powerful that so many masters couldn't stop him, only the eldest young master of the Lin family blocked him. Doesn't this mean that the young master of the Lin family is more powerful than Chen Kun, the head catcher in the city, and Master Wang and other masters?
Darling, this is serious.
Some people who know better have already begun to think about how to curry favor with Young Master Lin Xinru in the future.
"If the eldest young master hadn't taken action this time, I'm afraid the Lin family would have been in trouble." At this time, Mr. Wang regained his breath, covered his chest and sat on the messy tattered chairs in the middle of the lobby.
"I'm so annoyed now..." Chen Kun said with a bitter smile and stumbled over to sit down. "I didn't expect that the eldest young master of the Lin family, who is rumored to have accomplished nothing, is actually a legendary master of the family. I'm so rude..."
"You're welcome." Lin Xin is not a master of the family, but now he can only hold on. If the man in black doesn't go far and hears that he is not a master of the family, it will be troublesome.
"I just don't know what the trouble you are talking about is..."
Chen Kun shook his head.
"We will discuss this in detail later."
Lin Xin nodded.
"Brother, when did you...?" Lin Xinyuan ran out from behind and grabbed Lin Xin's hand with gleaming eyes. This cousin has always been lively and active, especially fond of martial arts and equestrianism.
"Everyone, big or small, go back and stay." Lin Zhiwu rushed over at this time. He had followed Lin Xinhu to arrest people just now, when a bloody arm walked through the door. Clearly injured.
After looking around, he glanced at Lin Xinru, who was standing in front of Lin Zhiwen, and An Ying, who walked up to him and pouted. Then he looked at the long sword nailed above the lobby, and suddenly took a slight breath. Obviously thinking about what might have happened just now.
"We will discuss this later!" Lin Zhiwen said in a deep voice, "Now everyone is making arrangements according to the original plan."
"Okay." Lin Zhiwu hesitated for a moment, but still nodded.
"Others follow me into the inner room first." Lin Zhiwen, with the support of Lin Xinru and Lin Xinyuan, slowly entered the inner room with his legs and feet feeling a little weak.
A large group of cousins ​​in the clan, various cousins, etc., as well as some distant relatives who came to look up to me, also made way for a few people.
Lin Xinru walked on the left side of Lin Zhiwen, looking around. Everyone he touched, young and old, could not help but lower their heads to avoid his eyes. Some showed a hint of awe, and some were unnatural and embarrassed. However, the girl in a green skirt who was wearing some revealing clothes gave him a flirtatious look, which seemed to be vaguely seductive.
"Huh!" An Ying couldn't help but hum from behind.
Lin Xinru gave her a thumbs-up backhand.
"Good cooperation!" A smile appeared on the corner of his mouth.
This little girl just listened to his instructions once and cooperated so well. She is really an excellent teammate!
An Ying was dangling her sword back and forth, feeling a little frustrated and unhappy. When she saw Lin Xinru's gesture, her little face suddenly showed a hint of joy, and she immediately felt better.
When he walked to the door, Lin Xin saw Lin Xinguang. The guy's face turned pale and he stared at him as if he had seen a ghost.
Too lazy to pay attention to him, several people entered the inner room.
The work of appeasing everyone was done by pre-arranged personnel. The real core members gathered together and went to a small room alone, with people guarding the outside to prevent eavesdropping.
Lin Zhiwen, Lin Zhiwu sat together, then Chen Kun, Mr. Wang, Lin Xin, and the restNo one is here, and An Ying is not from the Lin family, so there is no reason to get involved.
And the master of the Shu family is still unconscious. So there are only a few people who are really involved in the core.
Lin Zhiwen sat on the stool and breathed a sigh of relief.
"This time the Lin family was able to escape the crisis temporarily, thanks to the strong support of several people." He cupped his hands and thanked Mr. Wang and Chen Kun.
"The Master of the Lin family is too polite. Everyone gets what they need. We have received enough benefits that we are satisfied with, so it is natural for us to resist." Mr. Wang showed a look of shame. "I just didn't expect that the one who came this time was actually a master of the inner family. If it weren't for the eldest son of the Lin family, we would really have fallen short this time. I also deserve the Lin family's gift."
Chen Kun also showed a hint of shame on the side.
"You're right. The old man felt a little uncomfortable accepting this gift, and he didn't do much good."
"You two are too polite. That Qingluo Sword can actually use the masters of the inner family is beyond my expectation." Lin Zhiwen said with a bitter smile.
